title: Which accounts placed orders for household payment in Pisek?
question: Which accounts placed orders for household payment in Pisek?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id
FROM "order" AS T1
INNER JOIN "DistrictInfo" AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN "district" AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.k_symbol = 'UVER'
  AND T3.A2 = 'Pisek'
